howToAddACd: Every CD on the website comes from the list below. Newest goes at the top.
To add a new CD:
1. Upload the cover photo to the public/store folder (for example public/store/my-new-album.jpg).
2. Copy one of the albums below, paste it at the top of the list, and change the words.
3. Save. The store, the music page, the home page, and the All Albums bundle all update on their own,
including every place the site says how many albums there are.
Each album:
title        the album name (required)
subtitle     the small line above the name, like "2025 release"
cover        the photo's file name in public/store (required)
price        leave it out for the normal $10
badge        optional red tag on the cover, like "Newest"
description  optional sentence about the album
songs        the song list, in order
paypal       the PayPal button. Use whichever one PayPal gave you:
{ "kind": "hosted", "buttonId": "XXXXXXXXXXXXX" }
{ "kind": "link", "paymentId": "XXXXXXXXXXXXX" }   (from a paypal.com/ncp/payment/... link)
{ "kind": "hosted-sdk", "hostedButtonId": "XXXXXXXXXXXXX" }
stripeUrl    optional Stripe payment link; when filled in, it is used instead of PayPal
No PayPal button yet? Leave out paypal. The album still goes in the store, and its button says
"Call to order" (it dials Stephen's phone) until you add one.
Keep the quote marks, and put a comma between albums and between songs (but not after the last one).
